skill.name: system-settings-playbooks
skill.description: Use when the user asks what Manus can do with macOS System Settings or Windows Settings; wants help finding, understanding, diagnosing, changing, or planning an operating-system setting; or needs to choose among read-only diagnostics, official navigation and management channels, user guidance, and conditional Computer Use. Routes personalization, readability, notifications and focus, power, input, managed policy, and sensitive settings while keeping Mac and Windows evidence and mutation gates separate.
skill.userDescription: Find, diagnose, and safely change macOS and Windows settings.
exampleQuestions: Help me configure notification and Focus settings on macOS.
Diagnose why my Windows laptop is draining battery quickly.
Explain the safe steps to review my system privacy settings.
